tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gzhi gsum gyi cho ga'i lag len dang ngag 'don bsdus pa thar pa'i gru chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

gzhi gsum gyi cho ga'i lag len dang ngag 'don bsdus pa thar pa'i gru chen zhes bya ba/ smra ba rnams kyi mchog thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// tshogs gnyis 'dzin khri'i 'jing las rab bskrun pa// skal bzang yid mkhar rtag tu 'char ba de// bcas rang snang bas thar 'dod blo'i pad tshal// rgyas mdzad de ni yan lag mchog gis bsnyen// nyes gsum na kras gtams pa'i rgya bcas las// chos 'dul khrims kyi 'phyos 'gro bzang po ni// gnang bkag ba dan dkar po dang 'grogs te// rnam grol gling du chas 'dod 'di ston zhig /de la yang gnyis te/ gzhi gsum gyi cho ga dang*/ nyer mkho gzhan bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum/ dus gtan du 'brel ba gso sbyong gi gzhi/ dbyar gyi dus kho na dang 'brel ba dbyar gnas kyi gzhi/ dus nyi ma gcig kho na dang 'brel yang dgos pa phal cher la khyab pa dgag dbye'i gzhi rnams so// dang po la gsum/ nyi ma re re bzhin bya ba rgyun chags gsum pa/ dus bzang po rnams la bya ba chos 'chad nyan/ nya stong la bya ba gso sbyong rnams so// dang po rgyun chags gsum pa bya ba ni/ dge skos kyis gaṇ+ḍi tshad ldan rab gnas dang ldan pa thog mar dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal ba'i rjes su shang tsha lan gsum byas la/ rgyud gcig dang tog gsum ste/ rgyud re re la chung rim nas cher brtsegs pa bco brgyad/ slar rim pas smad pa bcu bdun/ tog sgra chen po gsum dang bcas pas dge 'dun bsdus la/ tshogs pa na des phyag gsum btsal te lus 'dud pas/ bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag dam par gyur pa gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pas gtso mdzad| dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng zla ba yar gyi ngo'i/ 'am mar gyi ngo'i gral tshes gcig sogs nas/ bco lnga pa mngon du gyur pa lags te/ gtsug lag khang gi bdag po dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi lha rnams kyi slad du zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa re bklag tu gsol|

zhes bskul/ gnas brtan gyis/ thams cad kyis dge bar gsungs shig /kun gyis/ skar ma rab rib mar me dang*// sgyu ma zil pa chu bur dang*/ rmi lam glog dang sprin lta bu// 'dus byas chos rnams de ltar blta// chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*// de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs// rgyu las 'gog pa gang yin pa// dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs// sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes 'don/ thog mar phyag 'tshal ba ni/ thams cad 'grengs pas thub sku mchod pas brjid pa la phyogs te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rigs pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i zhabs kyi rdul dri ma med pa la mgo bos rab tu gtugs te gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo khyod bltams tshe// sa chen 'di la gom pa bdun bor nas// nga ni 'jig rten 'di na mchog ces gsungs// de tshe mkhas pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba// ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra// grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lhang nge ba// mgon po mchog brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal// gser mdog 'dra ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum na mdzes// mnyam med mkhyen can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mi mchog 'dul ba kha lor bsgyur mdzad cing*// kun sbyor 'ching ba gcod mdzad de bzhin gshegs// dbang po zhi zhing nyer zhi zhi la mkhas// mnyan yod bzhugs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i gzhi// de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu// dge bas ngan song las grol zhing*// gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa| |zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo// grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston// bslab pa dag la rab tu gus// zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan/

dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*| spro na sems brtse ma dang*/ bzang spyod smon thung sogs 'don/ bar du mdo gdon pa ni/ shes rab snying po sogs sgrog /mthar bsngo ba ni/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// sogs dang*/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu// sogs dang*/ klu rgyal dga' bo nyer dga' bo// sogs dang*/ gnyug mar gnas par gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ dkar gtor spyi 'gro ltar byin gyis brlabs/ gtsug lag khang gzhi'i bdag mo lha mo 'phrog ma 'khor dang bcas pa la 'bul lo// bzhes nas/ 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams zhes sogs 'don/ gnyis pa dus bzang po rnams la bya ba chos nyan bshad ni/ gnas brtan gyis/ dus bzang po rnams la chos nyan bshad bgyi 'tshal bas chos bsgrags kyi mdo gsan par 'tshal/ gang zhig gser mchog rin chen ri rab la gnas man+da ra dang lhar bcas gnod sbyin dang*// gdengs ka nor bu'i 'od kyi mun pa sel mdzad sa 'og gnas pa'i klu rnams gang yin dang*// gangs can rir ni dpal gyis rol zhing rab tu dga' ba'i rig pa 'dzin pa gang yin pa// de dag thams cad thar pa dam pa'i sgor gyur thub pa'i gsung mnyan phyir ni 'dir gshegs shig /lha dang lha min mi'am ci'i dbang po dang*// brgya byin la sogs chos kyi phyogs la bya ba byas pa rnams// sangs rgyas gsung rab rab tu zhi zhing bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa// 'di dag bshad kyis dam pa'i chos nyan phyir ni 'dir gshegs shig /gang dag phyogs bcu stong gi 'jig rten na// bde gshegs slob mar gyur pa gang su dag /deng 'dir ston pa'i chos kyi char 'bebs kyis// nyan par 'dod pa thams cad 'dir gshegs shig /thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na dge slong brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum gyi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig tu bzhugs te/

de'i tshe dge slong rnams la bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag shes pa ni 'grib/ srog ni chad/ tshe'i 'du byed ni 'dor/ ston pa'i bstan pa yang nges par 'jig par 'gyur bas/ ci'i phyir brtson 'grus dang brtul ba brtan pos sgrub par mi byed/ mi'i lus ni shin tu rnyed par dka' na/ de thob nas des rnyed pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ba yang rnyed nas thar pa'i don dang mi mthun pa dag gis bslus te sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ta re/ dge slong dag srog dang bral zhing shi ba ni bla'i/ tshul khrims nyams shing zhig pa ni de lta ma yin no// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ srog dang bral zhing shi bas ni tshe 'di nyid kyi skye ba zad par 'gyur gyi/ tshul khrims nyams shing zhig pa ni skye ba 'bum phrag brgya'i bar du rigs dang bral zhing bde ba spangs te rnam par ltung ba chen po nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro// de phyir ston pas tshul khrims rab bsngags bshad// tshul khrims ldan pa sangs rgyas 'byung dang 'phrad// tshul khrims ldan pa rgyan rnams kun gyi mchog /tshul khrims ldan pa dri dang byug pa yin// tshul khrims ldan pa dga' ba kun gyi gnas// tshul khrims ldan pa gdung ba bsil ba'i chu// tshul khrims ldan pa 'jig rten kun gyis bstod// tshul khrims dag gis 'gro ba dam pa mnos// ji ltar sbrul gdug klu chen nag po yang*// tshul khrims ldan la gnod med gzhan ci smos// tshul khrims ldan pa'i dge slong 'od dang ldan| |tshul khrims ldan pa grags 'gyur bde ba thob// ji ltar mig med gzugs mthong mi rung ltar// de bzhin tshul khrims med na chos mi mthong*// ji ltar rkang med lam 'jug ga la nus| |de bzhin tshul khrims med na thar mi 'gyur/ /ji ltar bum pa bzang po rin chen snod/ de bzhin tshul khrims chos rnams bskyed pa'i gzhi// ji ltar bum chag rin chen snod mi rung*| |de bzhin tshul khrims ral bas chos kun gtugs// dang po tshul khrims med par gyur pa de// phyis nas mya ngan 'das pa thob snyam mam// sna med sna rdum la sogs gang yin pa| |de la me long dag gi dgos mi 'gyur/

/rna bas ma thos mig sngar ma mthong yang*/ /bstan srung mi de mtho ris 'gro bar 'gyur/ /thos mang thos ldan thos srung mtho ris rnyed| |bud med bsten du ga la rung*// rgyal po'i pho brang ga la dga'// longs spyod rtag pa ga la yod// bud med dag la rung ba med// rgyal srid dag la dga' ba med// dbu ba dag la snying po med// longs spyod dag la snying po med// longs spyod dag ni 'bab chu bzhin/ gru de ci 'dra khyim de 'dra// me tog ci 'dra gzugs de bzhin| |srog ni chu bur 'dra ba yin/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ nye bar 'khor la sogs pa'i dge slong de dag yi rang ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// zhes bsgrags mthar/ chos bshad pa las byung ba yi// dge ba grub pa gang yod des// mar gyur 'gro ba thams cad kyang*// srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog |ces bsngo ba bya/ gsum pa nya stong la bya ba gso sbyong gi cho ga la gsum/ dge bsnyen/ dge tshul/ dge slong gi'o// dang po dge bsnyen gyi gso sbyong ni bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa yin no// gnyis pa dge tshul gyi gso sbyong dngos su ma gsungs kyang*/ slob dpon chos bshes kyi lugs yin pas/ bshags pa yongs dag 'bul ba ni/ nyes pa so sor bshags pa ma grub na spyi bshags lhan cig bya ba ni/ gnas brtan gyi drung du/ gnas brtan dgongs su gsol/ bdag shākya'i dge tshul/ che ge mo zhes bgyi bas/ bag ma mchis pa'i dbang gis/ myos gyur 'thung ba dang*/ gar sogs dang*/ phreng sogs dang*/ mal stan che mtho dang*/ phyi dro'i kha zas dang*/ gser dngul len pa ste/ bshags bya'i nyes byas drug po las/ kha na ma tho ba nyes pa de dag gang yang rung ba byung ste/ nyes pa de mkhan po'am/ slob dpon che ge mo'i mdun du mthol lo// 'chags so// mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur gyi/

ma mthol zhing ma bshags na mi 'gyur ro// zhes lan gsum rang rang gis sam rjes zlos bya/ gnas brtan gyis/ nyes pa la nyes par gzigs lags sam/ des/ mthong lags/ gnas brtan gyis/ phyin chad legs par sdom lags sam/ des/ sdom lags/ zhes pa rnams lan gsum re dang*| gnas brtan gyis/ thabs yin no// des/ legs so// zhes lan gcig brjod/ slar yongs dag 'bul ba ni/ gnas brtan dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa'am/ bco lnga pa lags te/ zhes pa'i bcu bzhi pa ni/ hor zla dgu pa/ bcu gcig pa/ dang po/ gsum pa/ lnga pa/ bdun pa/ rnams kyi gnam stong yin la/ de lhag gi nya stong thams cad bco lnga pa dang*/ yang bcu bzhi pa 'byung ba'i zla ba drug po la bshol byung na snga ma bshol bton pa de bco lnga pa byas nas/ phyi ma de zla ba dngos yin pas de'i gnam stong la bcu bzhi pa bya ba yin no// de ltar gong 'og thams cad du nges par byas nas/ bdag shākya'i dge tshul/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i yang gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa'am/ bco lnga pa lags la/ bdag shākya'i dge tshul/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i bar chad kyi chos rnams yongs su dag go zhes bdag mchi na| bdag bar chad kyi chos rnams kyis yongs su dag par gnas brtan gyis bzung du gsol/ zhes dang*/ thabs legs bya/ dge tshul rnams phyir gshegs/ gsum pa dge slong gi gso sbyong ni lnga ste/ bcu bzhi pa/ bco lnga pa/ mthun pa'i gso sbyong*/ gnod pa spong ba'i gso sbyong*/ bkra shis pa'i gso sbyong rnams so/ de'i gsum pa ni dge 'dun gyi 'khrug long zhi bar bya ba'i dus so// bzhi pa ni yams nad sogs byung ba'i tshe na'o// lnga pa ni gaṇ+ḍi'i rab gnas dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi zhal bsro la sogs pa'i dus su'o// dang po dang gnyis pa ni yun du nyams su blang ba'o// de rnams gang byed kyang gso sbyong gi cho ga ni mtshungs pa nyid do// cho ga la gsum/

tshogs su tshang ba'i tshe spyir btang gi gso sbyong*/ tshogs su ma tshang ba gsum man chad la dmigs bsal gyi gso sbyong*/ rang gcig pu las med na gso sbyong byin gyis brlab pa'o// dang po tshogs pa tshang ba'i tshe gral du ma 'dus pa'i gong du bya ba/ 'dus ma thag gi sbyor ba/ las kyi mgo brtsams pa nas bzung ba'i sbyor ba rnams shin tu gal che yang*/ deng sang rang gzhan gang gis kyang byed pa nyung bas 'dir ma bris la/ spyi bshags thebs ma chag tsam ni/ dang po gnas brtan nyid kyi bshags pa mthong sdom dri ba'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba ltar grub rjes/ gnas brtan gyis/ dge slong rnams bshags pa lhan du mdzad par zhu/ zhes bskul/ thams cad mgo sa la dud lag pa thal mo sbyar bas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag shākya'i dge slong*| ming 'di zhes bya ba byis pa nyid dang*/ mi shes pa nyid dang*/ ma gus pa dang*/ bag ma mchis pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa mang ba'i dbang gis pham pa bzhi dang*/ dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum las/ ltung ba de rnams gang yang rung ba'i sbyor ba'i sbom po dang*/ dngos gzhi'i rnam pa'i sbom po dang*/ sbyor ba'i rnam pa'i sbom po rnams dang*/ ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu dang*/ so sor bshags par bya ba bzhi dang*/ bshags par bya ba'i nyes byas kyi sde tshan rnams las/ ltung ba gang byung ba de/ kha na ma tho ba de dag pa'i mtha' tshun chad nas bzung ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyi mdun du mthol lo// 'chags so// mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur la/ ma mthol ma bshags na mi 'gyur ro// zhes lan gsum brjod/ mthong sdom dris/ thabs legs bya'o// byin brlab ni/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ bdag shākya'i dge slong*/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum dang*/ spang ba'i ltung byed sum cu rnams las ltung ba gang byung ba de/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyi mdun du byin gyis brlab bo// deng ltung ba byin gyis brlabs te dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong mdzad la/

slad kyi ltung ba de dag chos bzhin du slar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ thabs legs bya/ yang rgyud dag par bsgrub pa/ gnas la blo mthun par bya ba/ dge 'dun mthun pa bsgrub cing nad pa sogs kyi gso sbyong nyams su myong bar bya'o// dang po rgyud dag par bsgrub pa ltung thun byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gnas brtan gyis/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa'am/ bco lnga pa lags la/ bdag cag dge 'dun thams cad ni ltung ba dang bcas par gyur na/ gang gi mdun du bdag cag ltung ba de chos bzhin du slar bgyi ba/ bdag cag las dge slong gnas gzhan du mchis la/ dge slong gi mdun du ltung ba de dag chos bzhin du slar bgyid par spro ba su yang ma mchis na/ gal te dge 'dun gyis dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang ba mdzod cig dang*/ dge 'dun gyis deng ltung ba byin gyis brlabs te/ gso sbyong mdzad la slad kyi dge slong gi mdun du ltung ba de dag chos bzhin du slar mdzad do// 'di ni gsol ba'o// 'di yan chad ltung ba can dge 'dun gyi las la 'jug pa thams cad kyi sngon du bya dgos pa dag go// gnyis pa gnas la blo mthun par bya ba ni/ gso sbyong dngos kyi sngon 'gro yin te/ gnas brtan gyis/ gsol ba'i las la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gnas thams cad grub pa'am zhes pa brag phug sogs gdod nas grub zin pa/ bgyis pa'am/ zhes pa/ khang pa dang*/ gur la sogs pa rtsol sgrub kyis bcos pa/ lags pa/ zhes pa bla gab de rnams gang yang med pa'i thang stong ngo*// de gsum las skabs su gang bab re smos pa'i mthar/ nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di/ dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su blo mthun par bzhed na/ gal te dus la bab cing bzod na/ dge 'dun gyis gnang ba mdzod cig dang*/

dge 'dun gyi gnas thams cad grub pa'am/ bgyis pa'am/ lags pa nang mtshams dang*/ phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di/ dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su blo mthun par bgyi'o// 'di ni gsol ba'o// brjod pa mjug sdud dang bcas pa la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gnas thams cad grub pa'am/ bgyis pa'am/ lags pa nang mtshams dang*/ phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su bzhed de/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyi gnas thams cad grub pa'am| bgyis pa'am/ lags pa nang mtshams dang*/ phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su blo mthun par bgyis na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag gnas thams cad grub pa'am/ bgyis pa'am/ lags pa nang mtshams dang*/ phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su blo mthun par bgyis lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to// zhes brjod/ gsum pa dge 'dun mthun pa bsgrub cing nad pa sogs kyi gso sbyong nyams su myong bar bya ba la gsum/ so sor thar pa'i mdo'i che ba brjod pa ni/ gnas brtan gyis/ so sor thar pa'i mdo la ston pa'i 'du shes/ rang nyid bslab pa la gces spras su byed pa'i 'du shes/ chos kyi tshul 'di la brten nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa'i 'du shes te/ de ltar thugs la bzhag la thams cad kyis gsan par zhu/ zhes brjod la thal mo snying gar sbyar te/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// snyan pa'i ba dan 'jig rten gsum du grags// dam pa'i chos sgra seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa// thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog mdzod brnyes pa// zhabs la tshangs dbang gtsug gi nor bus gtugs| |sdug bsngal rgya mtsho gting mtha' med brgal ba// 'gro ba'i gtso la spyi bos phyag btsal te// thams cad mkhyen pa'i bslab gzhi dkon mchog snod// 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi dbus su dbye bar bya// sangs rgyas 'dul ba gangs can mtsho// gting mtha' med pa thams cad kyi// gnas pa'i snying dang snying po ni// so sor thar pa 'di yin no// 'di ni dam chos rgyal po yin// chos kun gyi ni 'dren pa mchog

/'di ni dge slong tshong 'tshogs kyi// bslab zong tshong khang chen po yin// tshul khrims 'chal bas zin rnams kyi// gdung ba sel ba'i sman 'di yin// 'di ni lang tshos rnam 'phrul ba'i// rkang gnyis gzhon nu'i lcags kyu yin// mtsho bas zab pa'i 'khor ba las// sgrol ba'i brgal thabs 'di yin te// 'di ni bzang 'gror 'gro ba yi// nges pa'i chu lon zam pa yin// 'di ni nyon mongs pham byed lam// rgyal po yi ni 'dren pa mchog /'di ni thar pa'i grong 'jug pa'i// them skas gzhi dang 'dra bar gnas// nga ni mya ngan 'das gyur na// 'di ni khyod kyi ston pa'o zhes// rang byung nyid kyis gus bcas par// nan tan dge slong tshogs mdun bstod| |sangs rgyas zhes bya'i sgra 'di yang*// 'jig rten dag na rab tu dkon// mi nyid rnyed pa shin tu dkon// rab tu byung ba'ang shin tu dkon// de bzhin rab tu byung rnams kyi| |tshul khrims phun sum tshogs rab dkon// tshul khrims yongs su dag gyur kyang*// grogs bzang shin tu rnyed par dka'// 'jig rten sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang*// mi dang rab tu byung ba dang*/ tshul khrims phun sum 'tshogs pa dang*// grogs bzang rnyed dka' rnyed gyur nas// mkhas pa dag gis legs 'dod cing*// de dag 'bras bcas byed 'dod pa'i// sdom brtson rnams kyis so sor thar// mnyan pa'i phyir ni 'bad par bya// dge slong dbang dul kun dbang ngo*// sangs rgyas mi 'gyur rab byung ba// nges par thar pa 'dod rnams kyis// so sor thar pa rtag tu srungs// bskal ba bye ba rnams su yang*// so sor thar pa thos pa dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnyed dka' ste// sgrub pa'ang shin tu rnyed par dka'// sangs rgyas rnams ni 'byung ba bde// chos bstan pa yang bde ba yin// dge 'dun mthun pa bde ba ste// mthun pa rnams kyi dka' thub bde// 'phags pa rnams ni mthong ba bde// dam pa dag dang 'grogs pa bde// byis pa rnams ni ma mthong na// rtag tu bde ba nyid du 'gyur// tshul khrims ldan pa mthong ba bde// mang du thos pa mthong ba bde// yang srid rnam par grol ba yi| |dgra bcom pa dag mthong ba bde// 'jug ngogs bde ba'i chu klung bde// chos la goms pa'i skye bo bde// shes rab thob par gyur pa bde// nga'o nga rgyal zad pa bde// nges par byas shing dbang po dul ba dag

/dgon pa zhi ba rnams su rgas gyur kyang*// mang du thos pa nags kyi nang dag tu// lang tsho yol ba rnams ni gnas pa bde// tshe dang ldan pa dag /hor zla bzhi pa'i gnam gang la gso sbyong gi tshe/ sos ka rnams kyi zla ba phyed ni 'das pa dang*/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// lnga pa'i bco lnga la/ sos ka rnams kyi zla ba gcig ni 'das pa dang*/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// lnga pa'i gnam gang la/ sos ka rnams kyi zla ba phyed dang gnyis ni 'das pa dang*/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// drug pa'i bco lnga la/ sos ka rnams kyi zla ba gnyis ni 'das pa dang*/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// drug pa'i gnam gang la/ dbyar rnams kyi zla ba phyed ni 'das pa dang*/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// bdun pa'i bco lnga la/ dbyar rnams kyi zla ba phyed gcig ni 'das pa la/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// bdun pa'i gnam gang la/ dbyar rnams kyi zla ba phyed dang gnyis ni 'das pa la/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo| |brgyad pa'i bco lnga la/ dbyar rnams kyi zla ba phyed dang gcig ni 'das pa la/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// brgyad pa'i gnam gang la/ dbyar rnams kyi zla ba phyed dang gnyis ni 'das pa la/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// dgu pa'i bco lnga la/ ston rnams kyi zla ba gcig ni 'das pa dang*/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// dgu pa'i gnam gang la/ ston rnams kyi zla ba phyed dang gnyis ni 'das pa dang*/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// bcu pa'i bco lnga la/ ston rnams kyi zla ba gnyis ni 'das pa la/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// bcu pa'i gnam gang la/ dgun stod rnams kyi zla ba phyed ni 'das pa dang*/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// bcu gcig pa'i bco lnga la/ dgun stod rnams kyi zla ba gcig ni 'das pa dang*/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// bcu gcig pa'i gnam gang la/ dgun stod rnams kyi zla ba phyed dang gnyis ni 'das pa dang*/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// bcu gnyis pa'i bco lnga la/

dgun stod rnams kyi zla ba phyed gnyis ni 'das pa dang*/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// bcu gnyis pa'i gnam gang la/ dgun smad kyi zla ba phyed ni 'das pa dang*/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// dang po'i bco lnga la/ dgun smad rnams kyi zla ba gcig ni 'das pa dang*/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// dang po'i gnam gang la/ dgun smad rnams kyi zla ba phyed dang gnyis ni 'das pa dang*/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// gnyis pa'i bco lnga la/ dgun smad rnams kyi zla ba gnyis ni 'das pa dang*/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// gnyis pa'i gnam gang la/ dpyid rnams kyi zla ba phyed ni 'das pa dang*/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// gsum pa'i bco lnga la/ dpyid rnams kyi zla ba gcig ni 'das pa dang*/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// gsum pa'i gnam gang la/ dpyid rnams kyi zla ba gcig ni 'das pa dang*/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// bzhi pa'i bco lnga la| dpyid rnams kyi zla ba gnyis ni 'das pa dang*/ lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// tshe dang ldan pa dag rga ba dang 'chi ba ni mngon par 'ong zhing*/ ston pa'i bstan pa yang 'jig par 'gyur bas/ tshe dang ldan pa dag gis bag yod pa'i rnal 'byor du bya'o// de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub dang*| gzhan yang gang dag de lta bu dang mthun pa dge ba'i chos byang chub kyi phyogs rnams kyang bag yod pas thob bo// bcom ldan 'das kyis nyan thos kyi dge 'dun ni don nyung la bya ba nyung ba yin la/ dge 'dun gyis thog mar bya ba ci yod/ tshe dang ldan pa dag ma lhags pa rnams la 'dun pa dang yongs su dag pa dris shig /dris nas kyang brjod par bya'o// gnyis pa nad pa sogs kyi gso sbyong nyams su myong bar byed pa ni/ dge skos kyis nad pa sogs kyi rtsar phyin la/ nad pa des de la/ tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa'am/

bco lnga pa lags te| bdag dge slong bro 'tshal ba/ sdug bsngal ba/ bro tshabs che ba/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'ang gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa'am/ bco lnga pa lags te/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba bar chad kyi chos rnams kyis yongs su dag go zhes bdag mchi'o// dge 'dun chos bzhin du mdzad pa la 'dun pa 'bul lo// bdag gi gso sbyong yang yongs su dag go// zhes bdag mchi'o// 'dun pa dang yongs su dag pa yang brjod do// brjod pa yang rigs par bgyid do// zhes lan gsum 'bul/ len pa pos dge 'dun la 'bul ba ni/ tshogs pa'i dbus su 'grengs pas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa'am/ bco lnga pa lags la/ gnas che ge mo zhig la dge slong bro 'tshal ba/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa'am/ bco lnga pa lags/ dge slong bro 'tshal ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ bar chad kyi chos rnams kyis yongs su dag go zhes kho na mchi'o// dge 'dun chos bzhin du mdzad pa la 'dun pa 'bul lo| |de'i gso sbyong yang yongs su dag go// 'dun pa dang yongs su dag pa yang brjod do// brjod pa yang rigs par bgyi'o// zhes lan gcig brjod/ de nas gnas brtan gyis/ shākya seng ge de la ni// sor mo bcu yis thal sbyar te// so sor thar pa gdon par bya// gdul ba'i don du nga las nyon// thos nas drang srong chen po yis// ji skad gsungs bzhin bsgrub bya zhing*| |kha na ma tho phra rnams la// brtun cing byed pa nyid du gyis// rtag tu 'bad pas 'da' ba yis// sems rta kha blan dka' ba la// mthun pa gzer gnon rgyab pa yi// srab ni so sor thar 'di yin// che ba gang dag ngag tsam gyis// ldog cing mtshams las mi 'da' ba// de dag mi rta bzang po ste// nyon mongs g.yul las nges rgyal 'gyur| |su la srab 'di med pa dang*// nam du'ang 'dod par mi 'gyur ba// de dag nyon mongs g.yul gyis dkrugs// 'jog bral rnam par 'khyam par 'gyur// zhes brjod/

gsum pa gsol ba dang rnam par bzhag pa 'dzin du gzhug pa ni/ gnas brtan gyis/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa'am/ bco lnga pa lags te gal te dge 'dun gyis dus la bab cing bzod na/ dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ deng dge 'dun gyis gso sbyong mdzad de/ so sor thar pa'i mdo 'don pa gdon gyis/ 'di ni gsol ba'o// rnam par gzhag pa 'dzin du gzhug pa ni/ gnas brtan gyis/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag cag gso sbyong bya ste/ so sor thar pa'i mdo 'don pa gdon gyis/ khyed cag su la ltung ba yod pa de mthol zhig |ltung ba med na cang ma smra zhig /cang mi smra na bdag gis tshe dang ldan pa dag yongs su dag par rigs par bya'o// de ltar so sor dris nas dge slong gis lan btab pa de bzhin du| dge slong gi 'khor 'di lta bur yang lan gsum gyi bar du bsgrag par bya ba yin no// yang dge slong gang dge slong gi 'khor 'di lta bur lan gsum gyi bar du bsgrags pa na ltung ba yod la dran bzhin du mi mthol na de shes bzhin du rdzun du smra ba yin no// tshe dang ldan pa dag shes bzhin du rdzun du smra ba ni bcom ldan 'das kyis bar du gcod pa'i chos su gsungs so| |de bas na dge slong gang ltung ba byung ba rnam par dag par 'dod pas/ ltung ba yod la dran zhing mthong ba mthol bar bya'o// mthol na bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur ro// ma mthol ma bshags na ni mi 'gyur ro// zhes brjod/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi/ so sor thar pa'i mdo gdon pa la rnam pa lnga ste/ gleng gzhi gdon pa/ pham pa gdon pa/ lhag ma gdon pa/ ma nges pa gdon pa/ ril gyis gdon pa rnams so/ dang po gleng gzhi gdon pa ni/ gnas brtan gyis/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag gis so sor thar pa'i gleng gzhi bton zin to// de la bdag gis tshe dang ldan pa dag la/ ci 'di la khyed rnams yongs su dag gam zhes dri'o// ci 'di la khyed rnams yongs su dag gam zhes lan gnyis lan gsum du dri'o/

'di la tshe dang ldan pa dag yongs su dag na cang mi smra bas de bzhin du 'dzin to// gnyis pa pham pa gdon pa ni/ sdom la/ mi tshangs spyod dang rku ba dang*// mi la bsad par mi bya dang*// rdzun du smra dang bcas pa yi// chos bzhi 'dir ni gsungs pa yin// tshe dang ldan pa dag pham par 'gyur ba'i chos bzhi po 'di dag ni/ zla ba phyed phyed cing so sor thar pa'i mdo gdon pa las 'byung ngo*// yang dge slong gang dge slong rnams dang lhan cig bslab pa mtshungs par gyur pas bslab pa ma phul/ bslab pa nyams par ma byas par/ mi tshangs par spyod pa 'khrig pa las byung ba'i chos bsten na/ tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa dang lhan cig kyang rung ste/ dge slong de pham par gyur pa yin gyis gnas par mi bya'o// yang dge slong gang gzhan gyi grong na 'dug pa'am/ dgon pa na 'dug pa ma byin pa len pa/ rku ba'i grangs su gtogs pa/ blang na ji tsam ma byin pa blangs pas/ de rgyal po'am/ blon po chen pos bzung nas/ de la 'di skad ces/ kye mi khyod ni rkun ma'o// byis pa'o| |blun pa'o// rku ba'o// zhes zer zhing*/ gsod dam/ 'ching ngam/ spyug kyang rung ste/ dge slong de ltar ma byin pa len na/ dge slong de'ang pham par gyur pa yin gyis gnas par mi bya'o// yang dge slong gang mi'am mir chags pa la bsam bzhin du rang gis lag bdar te srog bcad dam/ de la mtshon byin nam/ de la mtshon thogs pa gnyer ram/ de 'chir bcug gam/ de la 'chi ba'i bsngags pa brjod kyang rung ste/ de la 'di skad ces/ kye mi khyod 'tsho ba sdig pa mi gtsang ba ngan pa 'dis ci zhig bya/ kye mi khyod gson pa bas shi ba sla'o zhes zer zhing*/ sems kyi 'dod pa dang*/ sems kyi kun tu rtog pa dag gi rnam grangs du ma dag gis de 'chir bcug gam/ de la 'chi ba'i bsngags pa brjod de/ de yang rtsom pa des dus byas na/ dge slong de yang pham par gyur pa yin gyis gnas par mi bya'o// yang dge slong gang mngon par mi shes shing*/

yongs su mi shes la mi'i chos bla ma mtha' dang*/ 'phags pa dang bye brag thob pa dang*/ shes pa dang*/ mthong ba dang*/ reg par spyod pa med la med bzhin du 'di shes so// 'di mthong ngo zhes khas 'ches pa las/ de ltung ba byung ba rnam par dag par 'dod nas/ dus gzhan zhig na dris kyang rung*/ ma dris kyang rung*/ 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag gis ni/ mi shes par shes so zhes smras/ ma mthong bar mthong ngo zhes smras te/ gsob gsob rdzun du smras so zhes zer na/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal ma gtogs te/ dge slong de yang pham par gyur pa yin gyis gnas par mi bya'o| |tshe dang ldan pa dag /bdag gis pham par gyur pa'i chos bzhi po dag bton zin to// dge slong gis de dag las ltung ba gang yang rung ba zhig byas na/ thog ma ji lta bar phyis kyang de bzhin du pham par gyur pa yin te/ dge slong rnams dang lhan cig gnas pa dang longs spyod du mi dbang gis gnas par mi bya'o// de la bdag gis tshe dang ldan pa dag la ci 'di la khyed rnams yongs su dag gam zhes dri'o// ci 'di la khyed rnams yongs su dag gam zhes lan gnyis lan gsum du dri'o// 'di la tshe dang ldan pa dag yongs su dag na 'di ltar cang mi smra bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to// gsum pa lhag ma/ ma nges pa/ ril po rnams ni lhag ma nas ltung byed kyi bar gso sbyong rer sde tshan res mos dang*/ ltung byed nas nyes byas kyi bar sde tshan gcig tu byas te lan rer rdzogs par 'don dgos shing*| de'i tshe lhag ma gzhan rnams ni thos pa bsgrags pas kyang rung bas mthar/ 'di skad ces/ tshe dang ldan pa dag slad mar pham par 'gyur ba'i chos bzhi dang*/ dge 'dun lhag ma'i chos bcu gsum dang*/ ma nges pa gnyis dang*/ spang ba'i ltung byed sum cu dang*/ 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu dang*/ so sor bshags par bya ba bzhi dang*/ bslab par bya ba'i chos mang po dang*/ rtsod pa zhi bar bya ba'i chos bdun po rnams ni/

zla ba phyed phyed cing so sor thar pa'i mdo 'don pa las 'byung bas/ sngar gsan pa'am phyis kyang gsan par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod/ gsum pa mjug ni/ so sor thar pa bton pa yi// bsod nams grub pa gang yod pa// des ni 'jig rten ma lus pa// thub dbang go 'phang thob par shog /brtsam par bya zhing dbyung bar bya// sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug par bya// 'dam bu'i khyim na glang chen bzhin// 'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya// gang zhig rab tu bag yod par// chos 'dul 'di la spyod gyur pa// skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs te// sdug bsngal tha mar byed par 'gyur// phan tshun tshul khrims bsrung ba dang*// bstan pa 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir// so sor thar pa 'di bton pas// dge 'dun gyis ni gso sbyong byas// gang gi phyir ni mdo bton dang*// gang phyir gso sbyong byas gyur pa// tshul khrims de ni bsrung bya ste// g.yag rnga'i rtse mo ji bzhin no// zhes brjod/ gnyis pa dmigs bsal gyi gso sbyong ni/ dge slong bzhir ma tshang na gcig gi mdun du gcig 'dug la/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa'am/ bco lnga pa lags la/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ bar chad kyi chos rnams kyis yongs su dag go zhes bdag mchi na/ bdag yongs su dag par btsun pas bzung du gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ deng gso sbyong byin gyis brlab bo// gang gi dge 'dun tshogs pa rnyed pa de'i tshe dge 'dun dang lhan cig gso sbyong rgya cher nyams su myong bar bya zhing*/ so sor thar pa'i mdo 'don pa'ang gdon par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod la/ thabs legs bya'o// gsum pa dge slong rang gcig pu las med na gso sbyong byin brlab bya ba ni/ lha rnams dgongs su gsol/ zhes brje ba ma gtogs snga ma bzhin du sbyar ro/// /

༈ /gnyis pa dbyar gyi dus kho na dang 'brel ba dbyar gnas pa'i gzhi la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ dmigs bsal gsum mo// dang po la gnyis/ ring ba dang*/ nye ba'i sbyor ba'o// dang po ni zla phyed tsam gyi snga rol nas/ gtsug lag khang byi dor/ sbyin bdag zhal ta ba/ spyod yul gyi grong dang bsod snyoms dang*/ sman/ gnas kyi bla ma/ 'thab krol can mi 'byung ba sogs/ mdor na zla ba gsum gnas pa la bar gcod mi 'byung ba'i nyer bsdogs bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ gnas khang*/ gnas mal/ khre'u/ chol zangs sogs tshang bar bya zhing*/ de stob pa'i dge slong gcig gam gnyis sogs bsko bar bya ste/ de bsko ba'i bsngags ni dbyar snga ma hor zla lnga pa dang phyi ma drug pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin las byed pas/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod dge 'dun la gnas mal stob par spro'am zhes dri/ spro'o/ zhes zer na las byed pas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun la dbyar gyi gnas mal stob par spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyis dus la bab cing bzod na/ dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba gnas mal stob par bskos te/ gnas mal stob pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dge 'dun la gnas mal stob bo// 'di ni gsol ba'o| |las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun la dbyar gyi gnas mal stob par spro ste/ de'i slad du dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dbyar gyi gnas mal stob par bsko na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la gnas mal stob par bsko bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsungs shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /ces lan gcig go/ mjug sdud ni/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba gnas mal stob par bskos lags te/

'di ltar cang mi gsungs bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to// zhes brjod/ stob par bskos pa'i dge slong des/ tshul shing srid du khru gang pa yo 'khyog 'chus pa sogs med pa/ dri bzang gis sbags pa snod du ras dkar po bting zhing dkris pa rgan pa'i mtha' logs su bzhag /'dud pa dang bcas pas 'grengs te/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bkra shis kyi gtsug lag khang che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di na khrims su bya ba/ klog pa thos bsam dang*/ sgrub pa bsam gtan la brtson pa dang*/ dbyar dge 'dun gyi nang du 'khrug long gi rgyu dngos pa'i de bzhin nyid la log par sgrub pa/ gdams ngag spong ba/ ltung ba dang bcas pa/ gsol sogs kyi las la 'du ba dang mthun pa mi sbyin pa ste/ mchan/ bzhi po gang rung gi sgo nas 'khrug long mi skyed pa 'di dang*/ gnas ral ba dang grum pa bcos pa dang*/ byin gyis ma brlabs par mtshams kyi phyi rol du skya rengs 'char bar mi byed pa la sogs pa 'di rnams yod pas/ khyed cag las gang khrims su bya ba 'di dang 'dis/ gnas 'dir gnas par spro ba des tshul shing longs shig /khyed cag las sus kyang dge 'dun gyi nang du 'khrug long bskyed par mi bya'o// khyed cag las gang gis 'ga' zhig las cung zad shes pa des da smros shig |khyed cag las gang dbyar gyi nang du dge 'dun las 'khrug long bskyed par gyur pa de la/ dge 'dun gyis phyis nye bar brtag par dgongs so// zhes khrims su bya ba brjod/ tshul shing blang ba dang dbyar gnas par khas blangs pa'i phyir dge 'dun rnams gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las kyis thugs bstun par bya ste/ las byed pas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi dbyar nye bar sgrub pa dbyar zla 'bring po'i tha chung gi tshes bco lnga lags na/ gal te dge 'dun gyis dus la bab cing bzod na/ dge 'dun gyis gnang ba mdzod cig dang*/

deng dge 'dun gyis tshul shing bzhes te/ sang nangs par dbyar gnas par khas blang ngo*// 'di ni gsol ba'o zhes brjod/ de nas stob par bskos pa des tshul zhing brim par bya ste/ dang po ston pa'i tshul shing 'bul/ de rjes gnas brtan nas dge slong rnams la brim/ stan las phyed 'phags te len/ dge tshul rnams la rang rang gi mkhan slob sogs kyis blang*/ brims zin pa dang*/ dal bus 'jog tu bcug ste/ mjug tu gnyug mar gnas pa'i tshul shing gcig gnas brtan gyis blangs zin nas stob pos 'grengs te thal mo sbyar la/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gnas 'dir dge slong grangs 'di snyed kyis tshul shing blangs so// zhes go bar bya// de nas gnas khang bstab pa ni/ gnas khang gi sgo lcags dang lde'u mig stob pa pos thogs te/ gnas brtan gtsug lag khang 'di rnyed pa dang bcas pa/ gos kyi rin thang dang bcas pa lags kyis bzhes shig /ces dge tshul gyi bar bstab/ yang stob pa pos gnas mal yang de bzhin du bstabs zin nas stob pa pos/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ khyed cag las gang gis kyang dge 'dun gyi gnas mal la gding ba med par longs spyod par mi bya/ gding ba rung ba ma yin par longs spyod par mi bya/ gding ba dri ma can gyis longs spyod par mi bya'o/ zhes go bar bya zhing*/ dge 'dun sang sbyin bdag che ge mo dang*| zhal ta ba che ge mo dang*/ spyod yul gyi grong che ge mo dang*/ nad g.yog che ge mos gnas par zhal gyis bzhes par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod/ sbyin bdag sogs dngos su yod na brjod kyi/ med na 'og nas 'byung bas mi dgos so// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ de'i phyi nyin tshes bcu drug gi skya rengs 'char ba'i dus/ rang rang gi gnas khang so sor dge 'dun du ma longs pa'i dge slong gi mdun du tsog pur 'dug pas thal mo sbyar la/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/

bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ nang mtshams dang bcas pa'i gnas 'dir/ 'di lta ste/ gnas ral ba dang*/ grum pa bcos pa'i slad du sbyin bdag la sogs pa ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dbyar snga ma/ zhes sam phyi ma zhes sbyar nas/ zla ba gsum gnas par khas blang ngo*// bdag dbyar 'di na mchis shing*/ bdag gi dbyar gyi gnas 'di lags so// zhes gsum brjod la thabs legs bya'o// 'di gang zag gi las yin pas gsum man gyi grangs nges par mi dgos so// gsum pa dmigs bsal gyi cho ga ni/ zhag bdun pa dang*/ bzhi bcu'i gnang ba thob pas zhag brgyad nas bzhi bcu'i bar byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga'o| |dang po ni/ mtshams nang der dge slong chos bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa rnam dag dang ldan pa/ mtshan dang lta ba mthun pa/ tha snyad gsum dang ldan pa/ lus tha mal par gnas pa/ bsam pa rang bzhin du gnas pa/ chos min gyi phyogs su ma song ba/ mal rang bzhin du gnas pa/ 'gro min bzhi dang bral ba/ byas pa dang ma byas pa dran par nus pa ste/ mchan/ dgu ldan gyi drung du tsog pur 'dug la/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ mtshams nang dang bcas pa'i gnas 'dir dbyar snga ma zla ba gsum gnas pa las/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba zhig gi slad du/ dgung bdun mtshams kyi slad rol du mchi ba dang*/ de tshun chad kyis slar mchi bar byin gyis brlab bo// bdag dbyar 'di na mchis shing*/ bdag gi dbyar gyi gnas ni 'di lags so// lan gsum brjod/ thabs legs bya/ zhag gcig dang gnyis sogs kyang de bzhin no// gnyis pa gnang ba 'di 'chags pa ni/ gang zag gi las ma yin pa dge 'dun gyi don yin pa kho na dgos so// 'di ltar las byed pas/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod/ dge 'dun gyi ched du zhag bzhi bcu byin gyis brlabs te/ mtshams kyi phyi rol du 'gro ba spro'am/ des/ spro'o// zhes brjod/ de nas dge 'dun la zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba gsol ba'i phyir phyag gsum btsal/

rgan pa'i drung du tsog pur 'dug la/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ nang mtshams dang bcas pa'i gnas 'dir dbyar snga ma 'am phyi ma/ zla ba gsum gnas par khas blangs te/ bdag dbyar 'di na mchis shing*/ bdag gi dbyar gyi gnas ni 'di lags pa las bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ zhag bzhi bcu byin gyis brlabs te/ dge 'dun gyi ched du mtshams kyi slad rol du mchi ba dang*/ de tshun chad kyis slar mchi bar spro na/ thugs brtse ba can dge 'dun rnams kyis thugs brtse bas nye bar bzung ste/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas gnang ba sbyin pa dang*/ gnang ba thob nas zhag bzhi bcu byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga'o// dang po ni/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di/ nang mtshams kyi khas blangs te/ 'di dbyar 'di na gnas pa lags pa las/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di/ dge 'dun gyi ched du mtshams kyi slad rol du mchi ba dang*/ de tshun chad kyi slar mchi bar/ dge 'dun la zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang bar gsol na/ gal te dus la bab na mdzod cig dang*/ 'di dbyar 'di na mchis shing gnas pa lags pa las/ dge 'dun gyi ched du/ mtshams kyi slad rol du mchi ba dang*/ de tshun chad kyis slar mchi bar/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ dge 'dun gyis zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba stsal du gsol/ 'di ni gsol ba'o/ las ni/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di/ mtshams kyi gnas 'di lags pa las/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di/ dge 'dun gyi ched lags na/ slar mchi bar dge 'dun la zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba gsol to// de'i slad du 'di dbyar 'di na mchis shing*/ 'di'i dbyar gyi gnas ni 'di lags pa las/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi ched lags na/

slar mchi bar dge 'dun gyis zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba stsol na tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba stsol bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung zhig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /ces lan gcig brjod/ mjug sdud ni/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba stsal lags te 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to// zhes brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ de ltar gnang ba thob pa des mtshams kyi phyi rol du nam 'gro ba'i tshe/ zhag brgyad nas bzhi bcu'i bar gang dgos byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags ni sngar zhag bdun byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags 'di nyid 'don pa bsgyur bas 'grub bo/// / ༈ /gsum pa dus nyi ma gcig kho na dang 'brel yang dgos pa phal cher la khyab pa dgag dbye'i gzhi la'ang gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum mo// dang po sbyor ba khri bsham pa dang*/ nongs pa dang bcas pa la bzod par gsol ba sogs ni hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes brgyad nas bcu bzhi'i bar la zin par bya/ tshes bcu bzhi dang bco lnga'i nyin mtshan gnyis kar chos 'chad nyan la 'bad/ de nas bco lnga'i nyin mthun pa sgrub pa/ rgyud dag par bya ba/ dgag dbye byed pa po bsko ba'o/ dge 'dun mthun pa bsgrub pa ni/ mtshams nang der yod cing na ba sogs kyis tshogs su 'du bar ma nus na 'dun pa dang dgag dbye 'bul ba'i cho ga ni des de la/ tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags te/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la mthong ba dang thos pa dang dogs pa'i gnas gsum gyis dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyi'o// 'dun pa dang dgag dbye yang brjod do// brjod pa yang rigs par bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rgyud dag par sgrub pa ltung thun byin rlabs ni gso sbyong gi skabs ltar bya'o// dgag dbye byed pa po bsko ba ni/

las byed pas/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod/ dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye byed par spro'am/ des/ spro'o// dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyis par spro na/ gal te dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang ba mdzod cig dang*/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dgag dbye bgyid par bskos te/ dge slong dgag dbye bgyid pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid par 'gyur ro// 'di ni gsol ba'o// las ni/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dgag dbye bgyid par bsko na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong*/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dgag dbye bgyid par bsko bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung zhig gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /ces brjod pa gcig dang*/ mjug sdud ni/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dgag dbye bgyid par bskos lags te 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to// zhes brjod do| |gnyis pa ni/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags te/ gal te dge 'dun gyis dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ deng dge 'dun gyis dgag dbye mdzad do// 'di ni gsol ba'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ spyir btang dang*/ dmigs bsal lo// dang po ni/ tshes bcu drug gi skya rengs ma shar tsam la/ bskos pa'i dge slong des/ rtswa dar+bha/ 'di lung las 'jag ma dang*/ gzhi 'grel las ku shar bshad cing*/ dz+nyā na shrīs ram pa'i ljang pa yin gsungs so// mchan/ dge 'dun thams cad la khyab par brim/ rtswa de yul rten gnyis ka'i lag pas phan tshun nas bzung ste/

dgag dbye byed pa po'i mdun du tsog pur 'dug la/ tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags te/ bdag dge slong*/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i yang dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags na/ bdag dge slong*/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dag la mthong ba dang*/ thos pa dang*/ dogs pa'i gnas gsum gyis dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid kyis/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis bdag la gdams su gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis bdag la rjes su bstan du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis bdag la rjes su bzung du gsol/ thugs brtse ba can tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag la thugs brtse bar mdzad du gsol/ ltung ba shes bzhin mthong na chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin slar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ thabs legs bya/ gnyis pa dge slong re re la dbyar gnas par ma nus na tshogs kyi dgag dbye go bar bya ba dang*/ dbyar nang nas glo bur 'gro dgos byung na gso sbyong gnyis sam gsum thal nas/ nya zhig dang bstun te dgag dbye bya ba sogs ni/ dge slong rgan pa gcig gi drung du/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags na/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i yang dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags te/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dag la mthong ba dang*/ thos pa dang*/ dogs pa'i gnas gsum gyis dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid kyis/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis bdag la gdams su gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis bdag la rjes su bstan du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis bdag la rjes su bzung du gsol/ thugs brtse ba can tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag la thugs brtse bar mdzad du gsol/ ltung ba shes bzhin mthong na chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin slar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ thabs legs bya/

dgag dbye byed pa por bskos pa des ni dge slong gzhan zhig gi mdun du dgag dbye bya'o// gsum pa mjug ni/ bskos pa des rtswa'i chun po rnams bsdus te 'grengs la 'di skad ces/ gnas 'dir dbyar gnas pa'i dge slong*/ 'di snyed kyis dgag dbye mdzad do// zhes go bar byas rjes su/ gral la 'khod pa rnams kyis/ legs par dgag dbye mdzad do// shin tu dgag dbye mdzad do// zhes go bar bya'o// slar bskos pa des rang gi rdzas khab yan chad cig lag tu thogasal/ btsun pa rdzas 'di lta bus kyang dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyir rung ngo*| |zhes brjod cing*/ de'i 'og tu dge tshul rnams kyis dgag dbye bya'o// de nas gnas la chags pa spang ba'i phyir tshes bcu drug gi nyin rgyang grags gcig gi sar ljongs rgyu zhing 'gro bar bya'o// gnyis pa nyer mkho gzhan bshad pa la bzhi/ gos| lhung bzed/ sman/ rin po che byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga'o// dang po gos la/ gos bzos zin snam sbyar bltab la/ yul bslab pa rgan pa yin na phyag btsal/ yul rten gnyis ka 'grengs te lag g.yon pa'i thal mo'i bar du bzung la/ gnas brtan dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i chos gos bgyis lags pa rung ba spyad par 'os pa 'di/ chos gos snam sbyar du byin gyis brlab bo// gsum dang*/ thabs legs bya/ des bla gos/ mthang gos/ sham thabs dang*/ sham thabs kyi gzan/ rngul gzan dang*/ rngul gzan gyi gzan/ gdong phyis/ rnag gzan/ g.yan pa dgab pa/ gding ba/ dbyar gyi gos ras chen/ skra gzed de 'tsho ba'i yo byad bcu gsum so sor sbyar ro// yo byad bcu gsum po de dag lhag po yod na/ byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gnas brtan dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gos snam sbyar lhag po rung ba ma bgyis pa/ rung ba bgyi bar 'os pa 'di mkhan pos lags par rung bar bgyi'o// mkhan po la yid gtad de bcang bar bgyi'o// rkyen ji lta ba bzhin du bgyi'o// lan gsum/

thabs legs bya/ mkho ba'i yo byad gos kyi khyad par khru gang yan chad gang yang sngar ltar bzung la/ gnas brtan dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gos 'di bdag dang tshangs par mtshungs par spyod pa la mkho ba'i yo byad kyi gos su byin gyis brlab bo// lan gsum thabs legs bya/ de rnams la yul med na/ lha rnams dgongs su gsol/ zhes sbyar/ rang gcig pus bzung bar byin rlabs 'chags so| |byin rlabs de rnams gang yang dbyung dgos na/ yul yod pa'i tshe gnyis kas bzung la/ gnas brtan dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gos bgyis pa rung ba spyad par 'os pa 'di/ chos gos snam sbyar du byin gyis brlabs pa las de lta bas na/ dngos po de slar dbyung bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ thabs legs bya/ dbyung ba ni 'tsho ba'i yo byad bcu gsum po ma gtogs mkho ba'i yo byad dang lhag po gnyis dbyung mi dgos so// gnyis pa lhung bzed byin rlabs ni/ yul rten gnyis ka 'grengs la/ lag pa g.yon pa gnyis kyi mthil du bzhag /g.yas pa gnyis kyis kha bcad la/ gnas brtan dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i/ lhung bzed zas la spyod par 'os pa/ drang srong gi snod 'di slong ba'i snod du byin gyis brlab bo// lan gsum/ thabs legs bya/ de dbyung na lag pa ya res bzung la sngags tshig kha bsgyur bas chog |gsum pa sman la/ sman gang yang byin len zin pa yul rten gnyis ka'i mdun du bzhag la/ gnas brtan dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i btung ba 'di thun tshod du rung bar byin gyis brlab bo// lan gsum/ thabs legs bya/ yang*/ gnas brtan dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i zhun mar 'di zhag bdun par byin gyis brlab bo// lan gsum/ thabs legs bya/ yang*| gnas brtan dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i 'bras bu sbyar ba'i sman 'di 'tsho ba'i bar du bcang bar byin gyis brlab bo// lan gsum/

thabs legs bya/ bzhi pa rin po che byin gyis brlab pa ni/ sbyin bdag dang zhal ta byed pa bdag po nyid du khas len du gzhug pa dang byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags ni/ gnas brtan dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i dngos po gang yang rung ba ma lags pa 'di rnyed de/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i dngos po rung ba ma lags pa 'di rung ba bsgrub par bgyi'o// lan gsum/ thabs legs bya'o// 'di rnams kyi go don rgyas pa ni las brgya'i 'grel pa rnams su rtogs par byos shig /smras pa/ dpal ldan zhi ba'i dgon par gnas bcas nas// gnang bkag khrims kyi nga ro cher bsgrags pas// tshul 'chal wa tshogs klad pa 'gems byed pa// thub chen gdong lnga pa des bdag skyongs shig /sdug bsngal

'khor ba'i mtsho las brgal 'dod rnams// chos 'dul gru chen bzang po 'dir zhugs la// gnang bkag kha lor bsgyur ba'i rol stabs kyis// go 'phang dam pa nyid du da 'phyos shig /'di dge zla ba ltar dkar ba| |khams gsum skye 'gro yongs la sbyin// don gnyis grub pa'i go sa der// phyin par shog ces bdag bsngo'o// gzhi gsum gyi cho ga'i lag len dang ngag 'don bsdus pa/ thar pa'i gru chen zhes bya ba 'di yang rang re yang ri sgar dang*/ gtsang sgrub sde gsar rnying sogs kyi 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i slad sogs dgos pa du ma'i phyir/ dbur stod 'bri klung du son pa skyu ra'i gdung las skyes pa/ shākya'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas sa khams nor skyong gi lo dbo zla ba'i dkar po'i rdzogs pa gsum pa la pho brang rtse ba gzhis kar sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ//
